name: Goose Monitor
notes: This ZIP contains the compiled Raycast extension in compiled/ and its source in source/. On macOS with Raycast and Node.js 22, extract the archive, run npm ci in source/, then use Raycast Import Extension with that source/ directory or run npm run dev. The compiled folder is provided as a build artifact, not a double-click installer. This GitHub Release does not publish to the Raycast Store.
